title: Pico ™ single use negative pressure wound therapy system compared to standard wound care with endoprosthetic care of the hip
summary: The healing of the surgical wound after a hip endoprosthesis operation is influenced by various factors. Diseases of different metabolic disorders, but also obesity can increase the risk of complications such as infections of the surgical wound. The complication of a wound infection can result in uncomfortable and long-term treatment for those affected. Vacuum wound dressings are a promising form of wound treatment for high-risk patients. In this study, patients after a hip endoprosthesis surgery are now treated either with the Pico single-use negative pressure wound therapy system or with conventional plasters. The wound dressing is checked daily until discharge. After a period of four weeks after the operation, the patients are asked by telephone about the current status of wound healing.
conditions: Infection and inflammatory reaction due to internal joint prosthesis
Complications of an open wound: Other

interventions.name: In this group, the wound is treated with the PICO vacuum wound dressing after the hip operation. During the clinical stay after the operation, the dressing is examined in daily visits until discharge. Wound healing is clinically observed and recorded.
